# The RT64 shaders the web page builds: one shader description a line, other mode L and H, color combiner L and H,
# flags, in hex. RT64 specializes each one's WGSL when the page is built and builds them with the game waiting: those
# above the first "section" line before the game starts, and a course's section when it first draws with its
# shaders, so that nothing draws with the ubershader, which integrated graphics can't afford (N64Recomp-browser's
# docs/porting.md, Prebuilt shader lists).
#
# Recorded by code, not by playing: bash tools/record_shaders.sh (its header says how) runs N64Recomp-browser's
# tools/record_shaders.mjs with tools/shader_plan.json, which loads the page fresh for each section, and
# tools/shader_survey.js tells the plan which screen the game shows. Section 0 is the launcher and the boot: the
# logos, the intro's golfers played whole, the title, the main menu, character select's cursor moved across the
# golfers with the stick and back, and the menus to a Tournament's course with A as a player does. Then toad_highlands:
# its first hole's flyover and four shots from it with the pause menu between. Then the other five courses, each a
# section of its own, recorded with tools/shader_plan_courses.json (record_shaders.sh's PLAN, with --add): the
# GameShark's "Have All Courses" opens them on a new save, and each plays its course select, its first hole's flyover
# and three shots with the pause menu between. Then mini_golf, by the same plan: the play modes' Mini-Golf, a course
# of its own, its first hole's flyover and three putts. Flags follow settings (filtering, HDR, MSAA, upscaling), so a
# change to one of those defaults means recording again. Each section ends with the shaders tools/play_plan.json's
# plays missed after the recording (17 in Chrome, then 11 in Firefox, 2 of them at the title), its shots landing on
# other lies, then the 8 tools/play_plan_pads.json's four players missed (four golfers on the menus, and on Toad
# Highlands' HUD), then 3 a Chrome play at 3840x2000 missed on Toad Highlands: what a section draws turns with where
# the ball goes and how many play, so a play's misses are added to its section (play_page.mjs prints them).
